summary: Preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package's preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) either uses a local `bun` binary or downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub, unpacks it to a temp directory, chmod+x's it, and executes the bundled `math_init.js` under Bun. `math_init.js` is a single ~727KB line of heavily obfuscated JavaScript using string-array rotation (`WV8StW`/`n7gIxM`), hex-mangled identifiers, and a runtime decoder (`hc1jfK9`), so the payload's behavior cannot be read from source. The dropper script `setup.mjs` is itself obfuscated with hex identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`) and property-lookup objects (`YCZJE`, `QkQej`, `JBhWy`) that hide the download-and-execute flow. Using Bun to run the payload also routes execution around Node-based tooling that would otherwise observe the file. The combination of alternate-runtime dropper + obfuscated auto-executed payload + obfuscated installer script is the alternate-runtime-dropper attack pattern: installing this package runs opaque, attacker-supplied code on the installer's machine at `npm install` time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
